thesis: Giełda Papierów Wartościowych w Warszawie (Warsaw Stock Exchange, GPW) is the dominant exchange group in Central and Eastern Europe. **[Fact]** The parent company and 16 subsidiaries operate listed equity markets (Main Market, NewConnect), fixed-income platforms (Catalyst, Treasury BondSpot Poland), commodity and energy markets through Towarowa Giełda Energii (TGE), clearing (IRGiT), reference rates and indices (GPW Benchmark), and minority stakes including Armenia Securities Exchange. **[Fact]** Consolidated sales revenue was PLN 464.8 million in FY2024 (+4.5% year over year) and PLN 132.3 million in Q1 2025 (+11.9%). **[Fact]** The group employs roughly 569 people and listed on its own Main Market since November 2010.
why_market_wrong: No dated structural discount or equity yield curve setup at today's price. **[Inference]** Polish capital-market recovery and record Main Market turnover in Q1 2025 may justify a quality premium, but at PLN 83.6 the stock prices much of that recovery already. **[Inference]** Foreign client revenue (37.1% of Q1 sales) and commodity gas spot growth are under-modeled in simple domestic-equity narratives, yet they do not clear our 15% annual return hurdle at spot.
